# MRPACK to ZIP Converter

> Client-side utility for converting Modrinth .mrpack files into launcher-ready ZIP packages.

Website: https://mrpacktozip.net/
Sitemap: https://mrpacktozip.net/sitemap.xml

## Core Page

- [MRPACK to ZIP Converter](https://mrpacktozip.net/): Convert local .mrpack files, direct .mrpack URLs, or Modrinth project IDs into launcher-ready ZIP packages.

## What It Does

- Reads `modrinth.index.json` from a `.mrpack` archive.
- Copies shared overrides and selected client or server override folders.
- Downloads manifest files in the browser.
- Checks supported hashes before adding downloaded files.
- Reports missing, blocked, unsafe, or mismatched files instead of hiding failures.

## Boundaries

This is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Modrinth, Mojang, Microsoft, Minecraft, or pack authors.

Local uploads are processed in the browser. Remote URL and Modrinth project modes fetch remote files directly from the browser.
